title: SAF3R: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2607.03612v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (F3R) transformers have recently achieved remarkable success. However, scaling them to long image sequences remains challenging, as the quadratic complexity of cross-view global attention quickly becomes the dominant computational bottleneck. While recent efforts attempt to improve efficiency through compressed or sparse attention, they fail to fully exploit the inherent sparsity and dynamic behavior of global attention. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of global attention across multiple F3R transformers and reveal that attention patterns are highly heterogeneous, dynamic, and extremely sparse across layers and attention heads. Motivated by these findings, we propose SAF3R, a training-free dynamic sparse attention framework tailored to F3R transformers. translated_title: SAF3R：用于前馈三维重建变压器的动态稀疏注意力机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.03612v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：前馈三维重建（F3R）变压器近期取得了显著成功。然而，将其扩展到长图像序列仍具挑战性，因为跨视角全局注意力的二次复杂度迅速成为主要计算瓶颈。尽管近期工作尝试通过压缩或稀疏注意力来提高效率，但它们未能充分利用全局注意力的固有稀疏性和动态行为。在本研究中，我们对多个F3R变压器中的全局注意力进行了全面分析，并揭示注意力模式在层和注意力头之间高度异质、动态且极度稀疏。基于这些发现，我们提出了SAF3R，一种针对F3R变压器量身定制的无训练动态稀疏注意力框架。SAF3R集成了定制稀疏注意力机制、离线头部配置和高效在线适应策略，以提升性能。
tldr: 本文提出SAF3R，一种无需训练的动态稀疏注意力框架，通过分析并利用F3R变压器中全局注意力的高度稀疏和动态特性，显著提升长序列三维重建的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAF3R, a training-free dynamic sparse attention framework that exploits the highly sparse and dynamic nature of global attention in F3R transformers to significantly improve computational efficiency for long-sequence 3D reconstruction.
